text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- IMF report sharply criticises Israeli government's budgetary policies.
- Israeli army chief Shahak says Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon conditional on Syrian pullout.
- Widespread search for missing Israeli soldier.
- Dror Adani and Hagai Amir convicted of conspiring to murder Yitzhak Rabin.
- Israel and U.S. formulate new draft for resuming talks with Syria.
- Hundreds searching for missing Israeli soldier.
- Stock exchange in West Bank city of Nablus to open within weeks.
- IMF interim report criticises Israeli economy.
- Central Bank continues buying foreign currency.
- Finance Minister Meridor says large budget deficit is the economy's main problem.
- U.S., Israel pen draft to restart talks with Syria.
- IMF issues highly critical report of Labour's handling of the economy.
